import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Standardize sex labels to lower case (missing values stay as NaN)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, coercing errors to NaN, then filter out-of-range values
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (should be positive); set negative values to NaN and drop those rows
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = None
    df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute mean body mass, ignoring NaN sex values
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().dropna().to_dict()
    return result
